findings.evidence: The proof defines π on the complex test space D(U) but applies R to complex tests. The cited in-run right-inverse supplier defines R on real-valued mean-zero tests, and no complex-linear extension is stated. Define R_C(f+ig)=Rf+iRg and carry over continuity and compact-support control. This is an immediate local repair. The proof pairs the spacetime distribution q with θ(x) alone, which is not a test on U=(0,∞)×Ω. The normalization is stated for a(t)θ(x). Define c(a)=⟨q,aθ⟩ and use aφ(t)=∫Ωφ(t,y)dy in the decomposition to close the uniqueness step. This is an immediate local repair.
